name: Gemcitabine (single agent, palliative)

institution.provenance: StewardMD draft decision-support protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: Gemcitabine is low-to-moderate emetogenic; give antiemetic prophylaxis as needed.

supportiveCare: Well-tolerated single-agent palliative option for transplant-ineligible, heavily pretreated relapsed classical Hodgkin lymphoma.
Monitor for myelosuppression (especially thrombocytopenia) and rare pulmonary toxicity.
Early palliative-care involvement and goals-of-care discussion in the refractory setting.
monitoring: CBC with differential before each administration (hold day 15 for cytopenias)
symptom and performance-status assessment for palliative goals

drugs.name: Gemcitabine
drugs.notes: Gemcitabine 1000 mg/m2 IV on days 1, 8, and 15 of a 28-day cycle (single-agent palliative dosing; the day-15 dose is commonly held for cytopenias). Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).
